title: CrownmarkResonance
description: Set activation specifications, active visual aura paths, and stat curves for signature crownmark matches.

tiers.name: Concordat Call
tiers.description: Legions matching Maegan's infantry element take 8% less field hazard skill damage.

tiers.name: Sigil Blitz
tiers.description: Basic troop attacks have a 12% probability to instantly recharge 60 rage points.

tiers.name: Aegis Sentinel
tiers.description: Field active skills deploy a glowing runic starlight boundary, restoring +3% total HP to surrounding allies every 2s.

tiers.name: Violet Orbital Rain
tiers.description: Command strikes trigger a divine orbital starlight beam dealing 420 Fire AoE skill damage to 3 adjacent cohorts.

tiers.name: Aether Shield
tiers.description: Protects allied marksmen lanes, neutralizing the first siege weapon bombardment.

tiers.name: Lunar Tide
tiers.description: Increases normal range-attack speed by 15% during nighttime field battles.

tiers.name: Celestial Sanctuary
tiers.description: Revives 12% of fallen vanguard troop units instantly at zero cost upon skill cast.

tiers.name: Moonbeam Cascade
tiers.description: Launches a rain of silver arrows, freezing targeted armies for 2.5 seconds.

tiers.name: Eversive Tactics
tiers.description: Shrouds matching cavalry troops, making them immune to long-range scout detection radars.

tiers.name: Blade Rush
tiers.description: Strikes on isolated legions amplify tactical shock damage rating by 18%.

tiers.name: Phantom Fog
tiers.description: Active skill deployments emit a thick smoke screen, reducing opposing commanders' rage generation speed by 25%.

tiers.name: Shadow Ambush
tiers.description: Automatically inflicts three critical strike strikes when emerging from forest terrain.

tiers.name: Pressurized Ignition
tiers.description: Accelerates siege engine movement speed by 15% and increases initial deployment range.

tiers.name: Clockwork Overhaul
tiers.description: Triggers immediate structural reconstruction upon capturing a fortress or resources tile.

tiers.name: Alchemical Fallout
tiers.description: Every 4th attack leaks acidic vapor, reducing target armor rating by 30% for 6s.

tiers.name: Steam Overdrive Overload
tiers.description: Double damage to defensive structures and structures garrisoned by less than 2 opposing hero legions.

tiers.name: Corrupted Arrowheads
tiers.description: Each basic attack drains 5 mana from the opposing commander and inflicts minor shadow sickness.

tiers.name: Siphon Vitality
tiers.description: Restores 50% of direct arrow damage to Allanna's vanguard cohort if the target is marked by the Abyssal curse.

tiers.name: Abyssal Gateways
tiers.description: Calls forth auxiliary shadow marksmen who inherit 30% of Allanna's base attack power.

tiers.name: Curse of the Broken Realm
tiers.description: When Allanna casts her active skill, all enemies within 400m have their defenses shattered and standard speed slowed by 40% for 8 seconds.
